Starts smarts, gets boring quickly. The basic idea of increasing your army, battle by numbers, makes sense, but there's a lot of silly pointless story between rounds, out of some dull fairy tale. It's not even an interesting story! Just let us do battle without all the padding and game fillers. The "free" version is crippled, you can't build a stonecutters hut, essential for the game; you have to "wait" hours or even days for upgrades or researches to complete.

Please make the game that is in your advert. Maybe an optional mode where it is ONLY the battle parts where you direct your army in to different plus, minus, multiply, divide circles. People mostly (90% of people as an estimate) click the advert for that game. Not the base building and story parts. Most people who come from the app based advert will be bored by these parts and will give a poor review because of this.

Meh... Basically the same game in a different wrapper. The game gets slow and dull as days pass which the developers rely on for players to buy stuff and progress quicker. It's not that good a game for me to spend my hard earned coin on unfortunately. After a week I've lost interest and uninstalled.

Waiting Game then unplayable without paying (uninstall)- The game itself seemed OK adding interesting story and building your city and battling enemies. I tried 3x then uninstall. they clearly want to force you to buy credits to speed up the march.

The Abrupt Paywall Total Battle started strong with a great flow, but it all fell apart at the first major task. The game quickly became unplayable, turning a promise of fun into a chore. The gameplay momentum was killed by endless waiting or an immediate demand for money. It's a "pay-to-play" scheme disguised as a strategy game.

Good strategy game if it worked, but unreliable, with bugs throughout, freezes quite frequent, and there's issues with options selected taking more than used from items. Issues with in app purchase, paying for items then not receiving them, and no contact from support for total battle, through message or email, and to top it off it crashed and wiped my game after 16 levels. I'd dodge this game as it has too much issues, unreliable. Joke to say the least.
